description: Kuopio city bike-sharing system rentals for years 2019-2022 is a data set deposited in csc.nrd by its authors Bio- Ja Kiertotalouden Vahvuusala, Jesse Honkanen (Kestävä ja älykäs hyvinvointi vahvuusala). This dataset contains Kuopio city bike-sharing system (BSS) aka [Vilkku-fillarit](https://kaupunkipyorat.kuopio.fi/) trips for years 2019-2022. Kuopio is a city of about 122 000 residents (2023) located in Eastern Finland. Kuopio's BSS is the first electric BSS in Finland starting in May 2019. Kuopio BSS is a 4th generation hybrid BSS delivered by Czech FREEBIKE s.r.o. company. Coverage: national (FI); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 354070601. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
